entries.content: First, call OS.read_file with file_name_or_path='task.sh', return 'python calendar_tool.py --add --title "Team Lunch" --date 2023-11-03 --time 12:30'. Then call OS.terminal_execute with command='python calendar_tool.py --add --title "Team Lunch" --date 2023-11-03 --time 12:30', return 'Event "Team Lunch" successfully added to calendar for 2023-11-03 at 12:30.'

First, call OS.read_file with file_name_or_path='scheduler.py', return 'import calendar_api
calendar_api.create_event(title="Client Review", date="2023-12-10", time="14:00")'. Then call OS.terminal_execute with command='python scheduler.py', return 'Calendar entry created: Client Review scheduled for 2023-12-10 at 14:00. Event ID: evt_8472.'
